# scripts/ops/Move-AvdStandingRegion.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Moves the standing subscription resources (run store, golden image gallery/identities, and source Network Watcher) from one Azure region to another without losing run records.
